title: Variational Contraction Conditions for Iterative Algorithms in Multi-Population Discrete-Time Regularized Mean-Field Games
summary: In this work, we study the contraction conditions of iterative algorithms for stationary and finite-horizon discrete-time regularized mean-field games (MFGs) with multiple populations, where each population only interacts with the state distributions of the other populations. Due to the high dimensionality caused by the interaction of different populations, contraction rates for these algorithms cannot, in general, be expressed in terms of radicals.
